episodes.209957: Thunderstorms developed along a cold front and led to a 59 mph wind gust in northern Hitchcock county and a 60 mph wind gust in Red Willow county at the McCook Airport.
episodes.210200: A 'pineapple express' of tropical moisture along a nearly stationary front brought heavy rain into southwest Oregon from 2/22/2026 into 2/25/2026. Storm total rain amounts of around 3 to 5 inches produced minor flooding of the Coquille River at Coquille.
episodes.210405: Rain and snowmelt contributed to a few river points along the Sacramento River reaching minor flood stage toward the end of February. These river points included Ord Ferry, Tehama Bridge and Vina Woodson Bridge.
episodes.211089: Rain showers and isolated thunderstorms, developed along a line extending from the northern Sandhills into the western Sandhills during the afternoon of February 25th. As this activity raced southeast at 60 MPH, it produced thunderstorm wind gusts up to 60 MPH.

events.narrative: The Coquille River at Coquille rose above minor flood stage of 21.0 ft on 24/1615 PST, crested at minor flood stage at 22.21 ft at 25/1630 PST. The river dropped below minor flood stage at 26/1045 PST.
Tehama Bridge reached minor flood stage for about 24 hours due to runoff from heavy rain and snow melt from February 24th through February 25th.
The river gauge at Vina Woodson Bridge indicated that it reached minor flood stage from February 24th through 25th from runoff due to heavy rain and snowmelt.
A 59 mph wind gust was recorded at Ambient Weather Station site Weather_Station_Hock.
The ASOS at the McCook Airport (KMCK) recorded the wind gust.
